# osc_service (Data Source)

Reads a service from the Open Source Cloud catalog, including the parameters an `osc_instance` of that service accepts.

Only services the workspace is subscribed to can be read with a personal access token. Set `subscribe = true` to subscribe the workspace to the service if it is not already, which is what creating an `osc_instance` does anyway. Subscriptions are free and only unlock the service in the workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "osc_service" "valkey" {
  service_id = "valkey-io-valkey"
}

# Parameter names, types and whether they are required, straight from the catalog.
output "valkey_parameters" {
  value = data.osc_service.valkey.parameters
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_id` (String) The OSC service id, e.g. `valkey-io-valkey`.

### Optional

- `subscribe` (Boolean) Subscribe the workspace to the service if it is not already subscribed. Defaults to false.

### Read-Only

- `api_url` (String) Base URL of the service's instance API.
- `category` (String) Catalog category.
- `description` (String) Service description.
- `id` (String) Same as service_id.
- `parameters` (Attributes List) Parameters accepted in `osc_instance.parameters` for this service. The `name` option is excluded since it is a top level attribute of `osc_instance`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--parameters))
- `service_type` (String) `instance` for long running services, `job` for run to completion services.
- `status` (String) Publication status in the catalog.
- `title` (String) Human readable title.

<a id="nestedatt--parameters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `parameters`

Read-Only:

- `default` (String) Default value suggested by the service, if any.
- `description` (String) What the parameter does.
- `enum` (List of String) Allowed values for enum parameters.
- `label` (String) Display label.
- `name` (String) Parameter name, use as the key in `parameters`.
- `pattern` (String) Regular expression the value must match, if any.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether the parameter must be set.
- `sensitive` (Boolean) Whether the service marks the parameter as sensitive. Put such values in `sensitive_parameters`.
- `type` (String) One of string, boolean, enum, list.
